title: Sonny Greer's drinking and why Cootie wanted to leave
summary: Cootie got angry at Sonny's drinking and falling off the drums, one reason he wanted to leave.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road
